summary: Explored the workspace profile override architecture by reading agent-client protocol definitions, server resource catalog files, and docs, then reviewed uncommitted changes introducing a new profile-overrides module. Confirmed the new profile-overrides.ts and its test pass (157 tests across 28 files green) and identified a stray blank line at EOF in apps/agent-server/src/extensions/registry.ts plus Svelte autofixer suggestions about untrack/$effect usage in WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte.
decisions: Workspace profiles gain a `temporaryProfileSource = 'workspace:temporary'` distinction handled by isTemporaryProfile/sameProfileValues helpers in apps/app/src/lib/features/workspace/profile-overrides.ts, so temporary edit-time overrides are merged separately from saved profiles.
CommandPalette no longer pre-detects domains before adding a workspace; it calls addProject with empty integrations and lets onSelectWorkspace supply them, simplifying the workspace creation flow.

Extension registry on the server drops the relative-path import and the standalone extensionFor helper, instead collecting extension profile contributions via extension.profile('.') directly in the registry listing.
errors: git diff --check reported a stray blank line at EOF in apps/agent-server/src/extensions/registry.ts:110 (command exited with code 2).
Svelte autofixer flagged WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte for calling `untrack` and other functions inside an $effect that may reassign stateful variables, suggesting $derived alternatives.
